messages:
maria_support: P1 ticket from customer #54321 — they got repeated latency alerts for frontend.latency_95 but the console graph is flat. Ticket: https://redwood.ticket/54321. Can SRE look?
metrics-bot: Alert fired: rules/latency-95 (frontend.latency_95 > 1200ms) — 3/3 windows triggered. fired_at=2026-03-14T10:15:30Z
jake_sre: assigning to @jake_sre. please paste alert payload + dashboard query. initial hunch: aggregation alignment or empty buckets causing bad denom.
maria_support: alert payload: `window_start=2026-03-14T10:12:00Z window_end=2026-03-14T10:15:00Z agg=avg`
Dashboard panel uses end-15m to end and rollup=1m. Quick TS check: most 1m buckets in that window are NULL.
ian_prod: Null buckets could be from downsampler emitting empty buckets after the recent deploy. Run this query to show bucketization:
```
SELECT
  time_bucket('60s', ts) AS tb,
  avg(latency_ms) AS p95_est
FROM metrics.requests
WHERE service='frontend' AND ts >= '2026-03-14T10:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-14T10:20:00Z'
GROUP BY tb
ORDER BY tb;
```
maria_support: query results (excerpt): tb=2026-03-14T10:12:00Z -> NULL, 10:13:00Z -> NULL, 10:14:00Z -> 450, 10:15:00Z -> NULL. alert still fired — looks like the rule evaluation treated missing buckets in a way that inflated the metric.
jake_sre: grabbed aggregator logs around deploy: `downsampler-v2` rolled at 10:11:45 with align change. log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T10:11:45Z downsampler-v2 INFO Applying config: align_to=30s, rollup_period=60s, drop_empty=true
2026-03-14T10:11:46Z downsampler-v2 WARN Emitting empty buckets for series frontend: reqs/latency
2026-03-14T10:11:46Z alerts-engine INFO Rule eval: rules/latency-95 window=[10:12:00,10:15:00] values=[null,null,450] treated_nulls=0
```
maria_support: customer reports false positives because their expected semantics are a sliding 3m avg, not aligned buckets. Our engine uses aligned buckets and with empty/null behavior + treat_nulls=0 the math made the avg appear high. Reverting align change in staging suppressed the duplicate alerts.
ian_prod: repro steps for SRE to validate: 1) run the SQL above, 2) run the equivalent of the alert eval (prom style): `avg_over_time(frontend_latency[3m])` vs `avg_over_time(frontend_latency[3m] offset 30s)`, 3) check filled_buckets count for the window. If filled_buckets < 50% of expected, mark as insufficient data and suppress.
jake_sre: immediate mitigations: (A) set alert engine to ignore windows with <2 filled buckets, (B) revert downsampler align_to->epoch, (C) run backfill for 10:00-10:30 to restore dashboards. I'll open PRs for (B) and (C). tagging @ian_prod for (A).
maria_support: :thumbsup: notified customer we are investigating and temporarily suppressing duplicate alerts. will update ticket with ETA.
metrics-bot: Suppression applied: rules/latency-95 by jake_sre at 2026-03-14T10:25:00Z.
jake_sre: next steps assigned: 1) revert downsampler config (PR #987) — me, 2) backfill missing buckets for 10:00-10:30 — me, 3) alert engine change to treat nulls as "insufficient data" and add integration test — @ian_prod. ETA: backfill and revert in next 2 hours.
ian_prod: on it. will add integration tests for aligned vs sliding semantics and null handling. ETA EOD.
maria_support: thanks team — keeping ticket #54321 updated. will close loop after backfill and confirm alerts stable.
